ALTERATION
18.1
INTRODUCTION
. Alteration (La'kks/ku) is an art. The same bodice block can be altered to make garments
for different people with different figures. The altered block ismade according to individual
measurements. Alteration of the basic bodice blocks enables us to make different designs
and patterns.
18.2 OBJECTIVES
Afterreading
this lesson, you will be able to:
•
explain what is alteration; .
•
develop a pattern with the help of a block;
•
make designs in a garment as desired;
•
demonstrate the different types of alteration.
18.3
WHAT IS ALTERATION
The changes made in the block made with standard measurements keeping in mind the
figure ofthe person are known as alteration. The alteration done in the block pattern
according to figure, style of garment or for placement of pleats, tucks, seams or darts as
per fashion isknown as pattern alteration. The dress pattern is developed from the standard
pattern. The dress pattern can be very easily developed by pattern alteration.

There are many ways of developing
the pattern from the standard pattern to fit the style
or size of garments.
There are-
1.
Extending pattern
When the block pattern is extended
length wise and widthwise
to develop the
dress pattern, it is known as extending
pattern.
2.
Decreasing pattern
When the block pattern is shortened lengthwise or widthwise as per requirement,
it is known as decreasing
pattern.
3.
Dart Lakks/ku
When a dart is transferred from one place to another it is known as dart alteration.
The dart is named according to its placement
on the block. If the waist dart is to
be altered on the pattern, it will be known as waist dart alteration.
4.
Yoke style alteration
When the dart is closed and different
types of yokes developed
according
to
style, it is know as yoke style alteration.
5.
Collar and lapel alteration
Collars are used according to figures, fashion or style. Any change made in the
pattern of collar is known as collar and lapel alteration.
6.
Sleeve manipulation
-The changes made in the sleeve block as per fashion or style are known as sleeve
manipulation.
7.
Trouser manipulation
When the trouser block is changed
to suit the style or fashion,
it is known as
trouser manipulation e.g. - makingjeans,
pant, bellbottoms with the trouser block.
DO AND SEE
Extend and decrease the pattern as per directions.

18.4 THE ART OF ALTERATION
Alteration isan art. The block ismade according to the body measurements and this block
is used for making any changes in the pattern. The same block can be used for making
different alterations and new block need not be made every time. There are many types
of alterations and they can all be carried out using the same block. Bodice blocks are
.different for children and ladies. They can be altered as per the design requirements or
to suit the figure ofthe wearer. For example, the same block can be altered to suit a flat
chested figure or a full figure. This is the art of alteration. Alteration can be done in the
following ways -
i)
Sleeve alteration

Trouser alteration
iv)
Collar alteration
